Lost in thought, Mornye forgets to disable the reactor emitter in her weapon system. A TARD-E Unit accuses her of using a high-wattage device and moves to detain her, only to be subdued effortlessly. Lynae invites both of you inside to talk over food. After you try the Research Institute food samples Mornye brought, she asks about your fight with Hyvatia. From her account, you learn that the New Solar Ceremony is approaching and that Hyvatia is essential to it. Just as she prepares to explain more, a TARD-E Unit interrupts. You escort Mornye out, and she invites you to witness the New Solar Ceremony together. Suddenly, a burst of frequency flows into your Tacet Mark. You have a vision of a man who addresses you as "Arbiter," pleading for help. You and Mornye decide to track the frequency's source. You find no trace of the frequency's source but uncover a new clue: the "Heliogyre" mentioned in the vision is an indispensable component of the New Solar Ceremony, and only the Roya can discern its workings. Just as you plan to question Roya students, a cry for help rings out. Maja's probe robots have gone berserk from Voidmatter contamination. Mornye proposes standard containment procedures, but you opt for a simpler solution. Based on Maja's description, the man who asked for your help is likely one of the Roya's Heliodic Six, figures who rarely leave the Solisylum. As a compromise, you decide to seek out one of the unappointed successors to Heliodic Six, Foreseer Yngvar. Maja advises you to speak to her mother, Astrid. You and Mornye pose as Academy professors when meeting Astrid, quickly finding that she appears to be hiding something. At that moment, a Void Storm erupts. You and Mornye locate the cause of the Void Storm: a device containing sealed Voidworm frequency. You and Mornye track the source of the sound to find a Soliskin. Reading its memories, you see Astrid burying the device that triggered the Void Storm. When confronted, Astrid explains that the device came from Foreseer Yngvar. Astrid tells you that Yngvar will appear at the upcoming Rite of Return. To find him, you decide to travel with the rescued Soliskin to a village named Haldarheim and take part in the rite. Haldarheim's village elder, Aksel, is initially suspicious of you, but Mornye gains his trust by introducing herself as Maja's teacher. You are invited to the pre-rite feast. At the feast, Mornye is visibly anxious about confronting Yngvar the next day. She relaxes only after hearing your encouragement. You name the rescued Soliskin "Buddy," and before the feast ends, you remind Mornye to rest. Unnoticed in the shadows, another Soliskin appears to have become contaminated. Later, you find Mornye gazing at the stars. She tells you her dream: to build a greater miracle than the stars themselves with human hands. To do that, she must ensure the New Solar Ceremony succeeds. The next morning, a commotion erupts in Bjartr Woods. Inside the woods, another device identical to the previous ones is causing a Void Storm. After shutting it down, you hear that same mysterious man's voice. A Shepherdess then approaches and invites you into the Solisylum, believing you to be the visitor who is predicted to stop the destruction. Mornye suggests splitting up. While you head to the Solisylum, she will investigate Yngvar and the origin of the Void Storm device. Through the Rite of Return, Buddy and the other Soliskin merge with the Solistrees, helping to strengthen the seal on a calamity deep underground. Elsewhere, Yngvar receives an order to ensure Mornye never makes it back to the Spacetrek Collective. Mornye investigates a lab she finds in the woods. She learns that the purpose of the Void Storm device is to contaminate the Solistrees, thereby triggering the Reactor Drive's emergency immune response, causing it to crash and destroy Lahai-Roi. After dealing with Yngvar who was sent to kill her, Mornye goes to meet you. With Lynae's help, Mornye identifies the mastermind behind the current Academy conspiracy: the Research Institute lab supervisor, Warren. Mornye assumes command of the New Solar Ceremony and invites you to input the data obtained from the Shaper in preparation for Helios's launch. Helios malfunctions because highly concentrated Voidmatter suddenly appears around Hyvatia, blocking its operation. To retrieve data critical to the launch, you and Mornye decide to venture directly into the Reactor Drive. The New Solar Ceremony succeeds. Back at the Academy, you meet Lynae and learn that Mornye, who collapsed from Overclocking inside the Reactor Drive, has regained consciousness. Though still physically weak, Mornye is out of danger. She tells you that inside the Drive, she saw what seemed to be a girl with a light blue ring who saved her. You decide this mystery will be your next goal. To celebrate the end of the crisis and Mornye's recovery, you, Lynae, and Mornye head out for a ride. Dr. Herssen discovers a suspicious individual who fainted near Hyvatia during the Void Storm. The man claims that just before passing out, he saw "himself." At its core is a replica of the Exostrider's calibration module, enabling a dedicated data link with the Drive to transmit real-time correction parameters. Hyvatia plays a vital role in ensuring the Reactor Drive's continuous and stable operation. * New Solar Ceremony - A Spacetrek Collective project decades in the making to replace the Reactor Drive in the sky with Helios, an artificial sun engineered by the Research Institute. Its ultimate goal is to retrieve the Drive as a power source to awaken the Exostrider slumbering in the frostlands, all while keeping Lahai-Roi's ecosystem stable. * Helios - The artificial sun crafted by the Spacetrek Collective: Research Institute to replace the Reactor Drive in the New Solar Ceremony. For successful operation, it requires environmental data from Hyvatia and raw observational data on the Reactor Drive provided by the Heliogyre. * [[Heliogyre]] - An artifact used exclusively by the Heliodic Six to observe the Reactor Drive.
During the New Solar Ceremony, it provides Helios with raw observational data on the Reactor Drive. * [[Exoswarm]] Material - Materials harvested from Exoswarm. Though still essentially parts of the Exostrider, they are widely utilized in engineering Lahai-Roi's various constructs. * Shephards - Roya chosen by the Soliskin for their pure nature become Shepherds. Their duty is to guide and care for the Soliskin. They lead the Soliskin to the best sunlit areas of Bjartr Woods and keep them safe. * Solsworn - Individuals gifted in calendrical calculation and a degree of resonance with the Exostrider and Soliskin are permitted into the Solisylum. There, they serve the Heliodic Six as aides and the tribe as healers and teachers, all while being groomed as the Six's eventual successors. * The Heliodic Six - Roya elders such as the Eye, the Binder, and the Shaper. Each pair in the Six is entrusted with the roles of observation, archival, and extrapolation. They reside within the Solisylum, tracing the Reactor Drive's trajectories and forecasting Void Storms. * [[Soliskin]] - A type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness. * [[Bjartr Woods]] - The forest where the Soliskin dwell. Bathed in the light of the Reactor Drive, the woods remain untouched by the ravages of Void Storms. * Rite of Return - A ceremony held by the Roya for the Soliskin. During the rite, the Soliskin transform into ethereal energy forms. Guided by Shepherds, they enter the Solistrees and disperse into luminescence as they rise. The Roya believe this marks the Soliskin's return to the Exostrider. * [[Solisylum]] - The sacred ground of the Roya and the dwelling of the Heliodic Six. It safeguards Exostrider parts and serves as the central archive for all Royan records. With each operational cycle of the Reactor Drive, the Solisylum calculates its stability, tracks the birth and growth of the Exoswarm, and monitors their eventual return to the Exostrider. * Reactor Drive - The Exostrider's power core and Lahai-Roi's underground "sun."
Royan records say this energy entity was removed from the Exostrider and placed underground to sustain the haven. However, monitoring data confirms a gradual but steady decline in its energy output.
